title: Skills
subtitle: Register Claude Code skills. Published skills appear in the Skill Hub for all users and are served via

delete_modal.title: Delete Skill
delete_modal.confirm_prompt: Are you sure you want to delete skill:
delete_modal.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete skill "{{name}}"?

form.title: Add New Skill
form.source_url_hint: Paste an HTTPS git repository URL from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or a self-hosted host (e.g. github.com/org/repo or github.com/org/repo/tree/main/my-skill), or an HTTPS link to a .zip archive of the skill hosted on S3 or any static file server.
form.subfolder_hint: Path within the repository where the skill lives (e.g., plugins/my-skill). Leave empty if the skill is at the repo root.
form.archive_sha256_hint: Hex digest of the zip file. Claude Code refuses to install the archive if its checksum does not match.
form.name: Skill Name
form.name_hint: Unique identifier in kebab-case format (e.g., my-skill)
form.domain_hint: Top-level grouping in the Skill Hub (e.g., Productivity)
form.description_hint: Brief description of what the skill does
form.category_hint: Select a category or enter a custom one
form.keywords_hint: Comma-separated list of keywords for search
form.author_name_hint: Name of the skill author or organization
form.author_email_hint: Contact email for the skill author
form.lock_git_subdir: The URL already points to a subfolder, so this field is disabled
form.lock_archive: A zip archive is installed as a whole, so this field is disabled
form.invalid_url: Please enter a valid repository or zip archive URL
form.invalid_name: Skill name must be kebab-case (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only)
form.invalid_version: Version must be in semantic versioning format (e.g., 1.0.0)
